title: The kit has no class that hides text from sight but keeps it for a screen reader, so each consumer writes its own
foundBy: session agent, while building the campaign repository's review packet on the kit, which defines its own `.visually-hidden`
details: A table header or an icon-only control sometimes needs text that a screen reader announces and a sighted reader does not see. The kit has no utility for it. `src/styles/utilities.css` holds only `.text-label-upper`, and `EventLanes` writes the same rules into its own census class. A consumer therefore writes a copy, as the campaign repository's packet page does. A copy is easy to get wrong in a way nobody sees, because `display: none` or `visibility: hidden` also hides the text from the screen reader.
